title: A voice yelling 'freeze' saves him before the Two Bits bunker blast

tellings.quote: was going down the steps into the bunker and I heard somebody yell freeze so I stopped and I looked around and the whole bunker disappeared just vaporized

plain: Joe McMoneagle, a former Army soldier later known as a psychic in a government programme that tested remote viewing (trying to see distant places with the mind), told podcast host Jesse Michels about a moment at a fire base called Two Bits during the Vietnam War. He says that as he walked down the steps into a bunker he heard someone yell "freeze," stopped, looked around, and the whole bunker was vaporised by a blast. He tells it as an early sign that something beyond ordinary senses was guiding him.
